  option b line=40 recommended=false text="The heading heuristics as DESIGN-0013 had them (`^Phase\\s+…:` finds the span, `#### Tasks` scopes the list), kept as a permanent fallback beside the regions — two grammars to maintain."

question 6 line=99 title="Resolving a document by ID"
  resolved line=101 date="2026-09-19" choice="a" note=""
  option a line=103 recommended=true text="**Both `Find(id)` and `FindIn(type, id)`.** `Find` derives the type from the prefix through `ValidateType` (which already resolves `id_prefix` tokens, and `validateResolution` guarantees uniqueness) and serves consumers that only hold an ID, such as `task list`; `FindIn` mirrors `status set <type> <id>` exactly. *(recommendation)*"

question 9 line=143 title="Error shapes in repo"
  resolved line=145 date="2026-09-19" choice="b" note="typed errors everywhere. Review rationale: a typed API should deliver all of its benefits, and a caller that can `errors.As` into `NotFoundError{Type, ID}` should not have to re-derive those facts from a message. `UnknownTypeError` unwraps to the frozen `config.ErrUnknownType` so `errors.Is` keeps working. §2.8 and the `status set` row in §4 are updated."
  option a line=152 recommended=true text="**Sentinels for the yes/no cases (`ErrNotFound`, `ErrTypeDisabled`, `ErrExists`) and one typed `InvalidStatusError` carrying the allowed list**, with `config.ErrUnknownType` passing through. `cmd/` maps them to exit codes with `errors.Is`/`errors.As` and keeps its current messages. *(recommendation)*"
  option b line=157 recommended=false text="Typed errors everywhere (`NotFoundError{Type, ID}` …) — richer, more surface to freeze."
  option c line=159 recommended=false text="Sentinels everywhere; the allowed-status list is re-derived by the caller from `Cfg`."
  option d line=161 recommended=false text="Other."
question 10 line=163 title="Generic facts for the next type package"
  resolved line=165 date="2026-09-19" choice="" note="superseded by DESIGN-0015. The question asked whether to add two helpers ahead of a second type package: a level-2-heading span reader (`docparse.Sections`) and an ID-prefix-to-type mapper (`document.Kind`). Regions make the first redundant — typed spans are exactly what the next package wants, and heading spans are the heuristic being retired — and `Repo.Find` already does the second through `config.ValidateType`. Both are dropped. Amended 2026-09-19. The second type package did not wait: every built-in is a structured type and ships its package in this unit (§2.9). What they share — open questions, references, decisions, criteria, alternatives, fields, list items — lives in `pkg/doczcore/kinds` (§2.12), and `docparse` gains the two facts they need, `ListItems` and `Tables`. `document.Kind` stays dropped."
  option a line=180 recommended=true text="**Defer** `docparse.Sections` and `document.Kind` until a second type package exists; the shapes are noted so they are not redesigned. *(recommendation)*"
  option b line=183 recommended=false text="Add `docparse.Sections` now — small, but a frozen API with no caller."
  option c line=184 recommended=false text="Other."

question 12 line=199 title="Hooks for wiki"
  resolved line=201 date="2026-09-19" choice="a" note="Hooks would give the wiki almost nothing: `UpdateNav` is one YAML read, a title walk over the docs tree, and one YAML write, and the two debug lines `cmd/wiki.go` logs today are derivable from `NavReport` after the call. Cancelling the title walk on a large tree is what matters, and the context covers that."
  option a line=207 recommended=true text="**None; the nav report is enough.** `wiki.Init` and `UpdateNav` take a context for cancellation and return reports; the two debug lines `cmd/wiki.go` logs today are derivable from `NavReport` after the call. A `wiki.Hooks` can be added later without breaking anything. *(recommendation)*"
  option b line=212 recommended=false text="A `wiki.Hooks` mirroring `repo.Hooks` from day one, so both L3 packages instrument the same way."
  option c line=214 recommended=false text="Other."
